corrections.note: original results and audit files unchanged; report wording corrected only
withdrawn: rank corr(NEES, predicted sigma) as a calibration test
pooled empirical correlation as evidence against the Hessian conditional covariance
claim that the original predicted correlations were not reproducible
sqrt(NEES)*sigma_xy as an estimate of translational error

estimator.information: Omega = 1/sigma_range^2, isotropic; H = sum w_i J_i^T J_i
estimator.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(1), one stream per process, shared by all frames

frame_selection: range(1, n_scans, 40)[:frame_budget]; frames dropping below 60/50 points are skipped, so 60 attempted yields 50 usable on static_0 and 60 on lt_changes_0
honesty_note: These values were read back out of the scripts that actually ran on 2026-10-20. They were NOT pre-registered before execution. Any future run must freeze this file first and diff against it afterwards. The 2026-10-21 audit withdrew the original 'effective noise is 3x nominal' framing: the sigma scan is an identity of the implementation, not an experiment. The surviving evidence is scale free.

metrics.ci_interval: not applicable: no confidence interval is computed
metrics.correlation: Hessian side: corr of H^-1 per frame then averaged; empirical side: Pearson on e
metrics.degeneracy_mixed_units: lambda_min/lambda_max of the 3x3 H (NOT unit invariant)
metrics.degeneracy_translation_only: lambda_min/lambda_max of the 2x2 xy block (unit invariant)
metrics.nees: e^T H e with Sigma = H^-1 and 3 dof
metrics.scale_free_tail_shape: u = NEES / median(NEES); invariant under Sigma -> k*Sigma. Compared against chi2_3 quantiles divided by its median (p90 2.642, p99 4.795, p99.9 6.875).
metrics.sigma_scan_status: NOT independent: the three sigma rows share identical error vectors to 1e-16 and H ratios of exactly (0.02/sigma)^2, because the Huber weight does not depend on sigma
metrics.tail_confidence: predicted sigma_xy = sqrt(trace(inv(H)[:2,:2])); its ratio between tail and rest frames is scale free; rank correlation between NEES and predicted sigma measures whether the model knows which frames fail
metrics.tail_rule: NEES >= p90 of the same condition
